params._poolManager: The Uniswap V4 PoolManager for cross-token swaps.                       Pass address(0) if cross-token is not needed yet.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

registerSettlementPool((address,address,.details: Stores the pool key in both directions so lookups work regardless       of which token is input vs output.

params.pool: The PoolKey for the V4 pool (with our hook attached).

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

unlockCallback(bytes).details: Inside this callback we have access to PoolManager's transient accounting.       For each cross-token settlement:       1. Withdraw input tokens from PaymentPool to BatchSettler       2. Transfer input tokens to PoolManager (settle the debt)       3. Execute the swap with hookData containing batchSize       4. Take output tokens from PoolManager       5. Transfer output tokens to the merchant's recipient

constructor.notice: Links this BatchSettler to PaymentPool, IntentVault, and PoolManager.

executeBatch(bytes32,(address,address,ui.notice: Executes a batch of settlements atomically.         Handles both same-token (direct transfer) and cross-token (V4 swap).

hasPool(address,address).notice: Tracks whether a pool has been registered for a token pair.

registerSettlementPool((address,address,.notice: Registers a V4 pool for cross-token settlements.         The pool must already be initialized in PoolManager with our hook.

settlementPools(address,address).notice: Registered V4 pool keys for cross-token settlements.         settlementPools[tokenA][tokenB] = PoolKey for that pair.         Stored both directions: [USDC][EURC] and [EURC][USDC] point to same pool.

unlockCallback(bytes).notice: Called by PoolManager during unlock(). Executes all cross-token swaps.

validateBatch((address,address,uint256,a.notice: Checks if a batch would succeed without executing it.         Validates both same-token and cross-token settlements.
